title: Add missing timeouts to async operations across 15+ files (~31 instances)
description:
## Source
SonarQube static analysis audit (`Data/Pages/audits/ms-sonar-static-analysis-7-26-26.md`)

## Findings
~31 instances across 15+ files where async operations are invoked without timeouts, risking indefinite hangs and resource exhaustion.

Affected files include:
- `MemorySmith.App/Components/Pages/Admin.razor` (L1730)
- `MemorySmith.App/Components/Pages/Chat.razor` (L2619)
- `MemorySmith.App/Components/Pages/Models.razor` (L420)
- `MemorySmith.App/Components/Pages/Pages.razor` (L795)
- `MemorySmith.App/Components/Pages/Tasks.razor` (L811)
- `MemorySmith.App/Services/ChatMarkdownRenderer.cs` (L413-414)
- `MemorySmith.App/Services/ChatReferenceLinkPolicy.cs` (L8-11, L17)
- `MemorySmith.App/Services/CodeSearchService.cs` (L134-135)
- `MemorySmith.App/Services/MaintenanceAgentServices.cs` (L657, L970-971, L1259, L1266-1267, L1703)
- `MemorySmith.App/Services/MeasurementBaselineService.cs` (L121)
- `MemorySmith.App/Services/PageService.cs` (L242)
- `MemorySmith.App/Services/TagGovernanceService.cs` (L32-33, L272)
- `MemorySmith.App/Services/TaskDomainService.cs` (L863, L874, L973, L985, L1082, L1229)
- `MemorySmith.App/Services/Training/ChatTranscriptWriter.cs` (L16-17)
- `MemorySmith.Benchmarks/CodeSearchBenchmarks.cs` (L191)

## Impact
Async operations without timeouts can hang indefinitely, causing resource leaks, thread pool starvation, and degraded service availability.

## Action Required
Add `CancellationToken` with a timeout via `CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(timeout)` to each async call. Use named constants for timeout values (e.g., `DefaultHttpTimeoutSeconds = 30`).

## Effort
~2h35min

## Priority
P1 — Reliability
